description: This file contains C source code for a set of utility functions related to parsing Wi-Fi Data Model Protocol (WDMP) requests and forming responses, specifically for unit testing stubs. It includes functions to parse various request types (get, set, attribute, table, add/delete row, test-and-set), map WDMP status codes to messages, and generate JSON responses with the cJSON library.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to extract a WDMP get request, filling a request structure based on request content and type.

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for setting parameters, filling the request structure with parameter names, values, and types.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to set parameter attributes, such as notification settings.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a test-and-set request, extracting old/new CIDs, synchronization info, and parameters.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a replace rows request for table data, capturing multiple rows with parameter names and values.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to add a new row to a table, extracting row data.

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to delete a specific row from a table based on row identifier.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Builds a JSON response for a WDMP get request, including parameters, values, and status.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_attr_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Builds a JSON response for get attribute requests, including attribute notifications.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Constructs a JSON response after a set request, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_table_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Creates a JSON response for table operations, like row addition or deletion.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_test_and_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Generates a response for test-and-set operations, including synchronization status.

methods.name: void mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage(WDMP_STATUS status,char * result)
methods.description: Maps WDMP status codes to human-readable message strings.

methods.name: void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE * statusCode,int paramCount,WDMP_STATUS * ret)
methods.description: Determines overall response status code based on individual parameter statuses.

ctags.name: getStatusCode
ctags.pattern: /^ void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE *statusCode, int paramCount, WDMP_STATUS * ret)$/
